title: THE ANISOTROPY MASS-BIAS -- the Jeans-correction to the X-COP masses with the measured beta(r): the bias factor, the re-run of the key closures, and the three verdicts

context.G209: the full beta profile from the HeCS members: E1 two-asymptote (1.270, 4.360) per-bin 0.033/0.093/0.173/0.305/0.560; E2 free piecewise -0.369/0.011/0.285/0.256/0.545 (+0.748 tail); window means resolved 0.438 +- 0.014
context.G203_G206: the NFW c500=4.5 Jeans+Abel forward model (the virial/Jeans machinery) reused verbatim for sigma_los(M, beta)
context.G135: the 2/3 temperature law on the HSE masses (cluster rms 0.067, scatter 0.052 dex)
context.G184: the outer-slope test: dark residual -2.17 +- 0.32, dust envelope -2.28 +- 0.35 on (600 kpc, R500); theory band [-2.4,-2.0] vs NFW -3

derivation.jeans: d(rho sigma_r^2)/dr + 2 beta rho sigma_r^2/r = -rho G M/r^2  ->  M_beta(r) = M_0(r) - 2 beta(r) r sigma_r^2(r)/G,  M_beta/M_0 = 1 - 2 beta sigma_r^2 r/(G M_0) < 1 for beta > 0 (the isotropic inversion overestimates)
derivation.projected: q(R) = M(beta)/M(beta=0) = [sigma_los(R; beta=0)/sigma_los(R; beta)]^2 on the committed NFW c500 = 4.5 forward model (sigma_los ~ sqrt(M) f(beta) at fixed R/R500)

bias.direction: DOWN: the isotropic (beta=0) reading overestimates the Jeans mass by the median factor

temperature_law.closure: the 2/3 shape survives (scatter invariant); the zero-parameter mean absorbs the bias

outer_slope.honest_face_split: the dark residual and total survive in-band; the (600,R500) dust-envelope concat flattens out of band (normalization-sensitive subtraction); the G108 (r_M,R500) envelope softens -2.38 -> -2.30 (in-band)

verdicts.V1: THE MASS-BIAS CORRECTION: M(beta)/M(beta=0) at the M500 aperture with the measured two-asymptote beta(r) (0.033 -> 0.560, G209 E1) is q = 0.891 +- 0.005 (E1; local Jeans closed form 0.954; E2 piecewise 0.882 +- 0.032, combined 0.891 +- 0.007 incl. the estimator systematic) -- DIRECTION DOWN: the isotropic (beta = 0) reading of the committed HSE masses OVERESTIMATES the Jeans-solved mass by 12.2% (E1) / 13.4% (E2); the corrected M500-class falls from the median 5.655 x1e14 to 5.039 x1e14.  The bias is a systematic of the DYNAMICAL (Jeans/virial) reading of the HSE masses -- the gas-pressure hydrostatics themselves (the X-ray M_FORW) carry no anisotropy term; the correction applies to the sector's use of M500 as the virial/Jeans M_dyn.
verdicts.V2: THE RE-RUN CLOSURES vs THE ORIGINALS: (a) 2/3 temperature law: cluster residual scatter 0.052 -> 0.052 dex (INVARIANT, the shape survives); rms about zero 0.067 -> 0.092 dex; the zero-parameter mean offset +0.042 -> +0.076 dex absorbs the bias; pointwise alpha 0.75 -> 0.81 (2/3 drifts from 0.7 sigma to 1.1 sigma away -- the one soft face, still inside 2 sigma).  (b) pie: s_b 17.7% -> 19.8%, s_ph 56.9% -> 63.9%, s_d 24.6% -> 15.4% (the phantom:baryon ratio INVARIANT to 1e-9; the dust remainder absorbs the bias; negative-dust 1 -> 1/12).  (c) saturation: M_sat 3.09 -> 2.75 x1e14, relative position log10(M_min/M_sat) +0.052 -> +0.052 (INVARIANT).  (d) outer slope: dark residual -2.17 -> -2.22 and total -2.22 (exactly invariant), still in the theory band [-2.4,-2.0] with NFW -3 at 2.4 sigma; the G108 (r_M,R500) dust envelope softens -2.38 -> -2.29 (still in-band), while the (600,R500) concat dust-envelope face flattens -2.28 -> -1.35 (normalization-sensitive subtraction -- the envelope face's honest limit).  VERDICT: the closures survive in their ratio/shape/frame forms (4/4); the absolute levels and one subtraction-sensitive face move by the bias amplitude.
verdicts.V3: THE HONEST STATEMENT: the anisotropy correction is a REAL re-scaling of the cluster sector's ABSOLUTE masses -- the measured beta(r) (0.03 -> 0.56) lowers the Jeans-solved M500 by the median factor q = 0.891 (E1) / 0.882 (E2), a 9-13% systematic with a definite direction (the isotropic reading overestimates) -- AND it is SIMULTANEOUSLY a frame-preserving shift: because the beta(r) is a STACK quantity, the correction is a UNIFORM multiplicative factor, and the sector's ratios/exponents/frames are invariant: the 2/3 law's residual scatter (0.052 dex), the phantom:baryon ratio (exactly), the saturation's relative position (exactly), the total density's outer slope (exactly), the dark-residual outer-slope class (-2.2, in-band, NFW still rejected), the f-slope d log10 f/d log10 M500 and the u(M500) exponent.  What MOVES is the absolute bookkeeping: the T-law's zero-parameter mean offset (+0.033 dex) and the pointwise alpha's drift (0.75 -> 0.81, 2/3 now 1.1 sigma away, the one soft face), the pie's dust share (-9.2 points), M_sat's absolute position (3.09 -> 2.75 x1e14), and the (600,R500) dust-ENVELOPE outer-slope concat (-2.28 -> -1.35, out of band -- the subtraction face is normalization-sensitive; the G108 (r_M,R500) envelope only softens to -2.29, in-band).  The precise honest framing: the correction SHIFTS the cluster sector's absolute masses by a measured, direction-fixed factor, leaves every ratio/frame and the model-independent shape tests intact, and re-anchors the absolute levels and one subtraction-sensitive face by the bias amplitude -- it is NOT a restructuring of the sector, and it is NOT negligible for any single absolute mass statement (M_sat, the dust share, the T-law's constant).

checks.name: C1 [the derivation closes] the closed-form Jeans correction 1 - 2 beta sigma_r^2 r/(GM) and the projected forward-model ratio agree in direction and sit < 15% apart at R500 for the measured two-asymptote profile
checks.reading: the local Jeans form (exact algebra) and the projected estimator face both put M(beta)/M(beta=0) < 1 for the measured rising profile: the isotropic reading overestimates; the small difference is the LOS integration over the more-anisotropic outskirts.

checks.name: C2 [direction, both estimators] q(R500) < 1 for the measured profile under BOTH G209 estimators (E1 two-asymptote and E2 piecewise)
checks.reading: the measured beta(r), whether read through the two-asymptote fit or the free piecewise, lowers the Jeans-solved mass at the M500 aperture: the bias direction is robust to the estimator.

checks.name: C3 [magnitude] the median correction is a 5-25% effect at R500 (q in [0.75, 0.97]), NOT a factor-of-2 re-scaling
checks.reading: the anisotropy correction is a systematic of order 5-25% on the absolute masses: meaningful for the sector bookkeeping, not a restructuring of the cluster sector.

checks.name: C4 [the 2/3 law's SHAPE survives] the cluster residual SCATTER about the mean is unchanged by the uniform correction (<= 1.001x) and stays at the HSE class; the law's zero-parameter closure (mean ~ 0) absorbs the bias as a uniform offset
checks.reading: a universal mass factor is a pure shift of log10 f: the 2/3 exponent's residual scatter is INVARIANT (the law's shape), and the bias appears as the mean offset (2/3)|log10 q| ~ the correction amplitude.

checks.name: C5 [the pointwise alpha stays within 2 sigma of 2/3] the fixed-M_b exponent's median after the correction (the alpha DRIFTS up -- a uniform factor in f moves alpha_i = ln(obs)/ln f -- reported as the one marginal face)
checks.reading: the pointwise exponent is NOT invariant under the correction: with f -> f/q < f, alpha_i = ln(obs)/ln f rises (0.752 -> 0.808); 2/3 moves from 0.7 sigma to 1.1 sigma away -- a marginal drift, inside 2 sigma, registered as the law's one soft face.

checks.name: C6 [the pie's phantom:baryon frame is invariant] s_ph/s_b unchanged to 1e-9 under the correction (both shares scale by 1/q); the dust share absorbs the full bias delta
checks.reading: the equipartition phantom-to-baryon ratio is a pure frame quantity (R500/r_M): it survives the absolute re-scaling exactly; the dust remainder carries the mass bias.

checks.name: C7 [the saturation's RELATIVE position is invariant] the universal factor preserves the sample-vs-M_sat gap to 1e-6 dex (both scale identically); the ABSOLUTE position moves down by the bias
checks.reading: the saturation is a RATIO statement (the amplitude run's zero): the correction moves its absolute position with the masses and leaves the sample's straddle exactly unchanged -- a frame-preserving shift.

checks.name: C8 [the outer-slope verdict survives] the dark-residual concat slope stays inside the theory band [-2.4,-2.0] and >= 2 sigma from NFW -3.0 after the correction (both estimators' q)
checks.reading: the total-density slope is exactly invariant under a uniform mass factor and the model-independent dark residual stays in the theory band (NFW still rejected >= 2 sigma): the G184 discriminator's PRIMARY face survives; the subtraction-based dust-envelope faces are normalization-sensitive -- the (600,R500) concat flattens out of band while the G108 (r_M,R500) envelope softens -2.38 -> -2.30 (in-band) -- registered as the envelope face's honest limit.
